description: Per-method reference RI = the native RI of the sample type each clearing method was historically designed for / performs best on. Used as RI_ref in the S_trans Gaussian-RBF score: closer the question's tissue native RI is to a method's RI_ref, the better that method fits the question. Values are tissue native RI (from tissue_ri.json), not reagent RI.
support_gate: If (method, tier_code) not in time_kb.json lookup → S_trans = 0 regardless of RI proximity.

uDISCO.primary_sample: adult mouse whole body / long-range projections

interpretation.high_score: Question's tissue RI is close to RI_ref → method was historically designed for this tissue type.
interpretation.low_score: Question's tissue RI far from RI_ref → method was designed for a different tissue domain, even if technically usable.
interpretation.zero_score: (method, tier_code) not in time_kb.json → method does not support this sample size at all (e.g., CUBIC for plant, EyeCi for bone).
